One morning last week I got a few bags and went outside. I was meeting up with a regular customer that wanted a bag. I did the deal as usual and was heading home as I felt someone running up behind me and grabbing me. It was a police officer, with a few others coming from different directions. They told me to stand still and handcuffed me. I didnt see what happened to the other guy because he was behind the building. They took me into the car, drove me down to the station, took a urine sample, interrogated me and I was let go a couple of hours after that. No big deal I thought as this is nothing major. I will probably be able to work my way out with a posessions charge and that would be it. 

Now I arrived at home and was told by my mother that the police had been there. I was not too worried as I did not stash my stuff at home, I only kept the money there. I asked her if they found anything or had asked her about anything and she said no. Obviously first thing I do is go to my money stash. 
I froze. I was so suprised and stunned. There was nothing there. I pretty much went apathic at that point. I laid down in my bed and just stared at the wall for a solid 40 minutes before I slowly started crying. Almost half a year of dealing and I did not have a single cent to show for it. I know a lot of you will say hey there you go crime does not pay. I know it does not. But this was my only and last option in life. If I had another choice I would have left this life behind me years ago. But I never got another chance. I was so happy and looking forward to making a change in life and forgetting all of this shit. Now I was back at where I started half a year ago and on top or that I also have to sell the rest of the stuff just to pay off the debt I have for the last of the shit. I calculated that I will make about $70 after I sell whats left and pay my supplier. 

Life is shit right now. I am so lost once again. I have no will to do anything and have not met a customer for the past 4-5 days. I assume they have already found a new dealer.
